newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish zloty passively edges higher vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Polish zloty passively edges higher vs basket.

text.p: The zloty finished Tuesday's quiet session barely changed against the basket of currencies as small-scale client orders could not snap the market out of its passive mood, dealers said.
They said several banks tried to latch on to small client orders to create some zloty movement but that the local currency remained pitted around 3.1 percent from parity for most of the session.
"Small orders and intraday trading speculation dominated the day, but the zloty hardly budged," said Mateusz Bieniek, forex dealer at Societe Generale in Warsaw.
The zloty closed at 3.13/3.10 percent from the trading band centre, just up from Monday's 3.09/3.06 percent close.
It finished at 3.1290/00 to the dollar, down from 3.1198/08 on Monday and at 1.8059/65 to the mark, up from 1.8110/15.

Dealers said foreign capital flows on Tuesday were kept to a minimum, with foreigners mainly selling Polish treasuries in secondary trade, as international investors tended to concentrate on the Czech crown's swift rise today.
The Czech crown was fixed at 0.76 percent below its basket mid-point on Tuesday, more than a percentage point stronger than Monday's fixing at -1.9 percent from parity.

Dealers said the central bank again refrained from intervening on the forex market on Tuesday because it did not want to pull down the zloty and make Polish debt more attractive to speculative foreign capital.
In the past the central bank had stepped in with currency-buying operations when the zloty firmed above three percent from parity.
On the money market overnight rates inched down 0.30 point to around 22.60 percent in afternoon trade as cash inflows from the clearing session created additional liquidity.
Tomorrow/next closed around 22.80 percent, down some 0.10 point lower than Monday's close.
On Tuesday the central bank increased the average yield of its 91-day NBP-bills to 21.17 percent from 21.15, but the maximum yield fell to 22.18 from 22.20 at the previous sale.
